author: A Google user
review_text: For Topup Esewa Wallet You Need an Bank Account with Internet Banking thus Making this App useless. No way to add funds usijg Debit Card or Credit Card like IME. No Shop in Kathmandu Ready to Topup Esewa Wallet Quickly. I have tried in many shops near Golfutar, Maharajganj Retailers but no one from them Ready for Wallet topup. So for me this App is useless, Totally useless.
